astrometryImport.selection: Only rows with a nonempty HIP identifier; keep HYG id and HIP id in every row locator.
astrometryImport.frameCaveat: HYG says equinox 2000 but does not specify frame bias. HIP input axes are ICRS and author describes epoch propagation. Treat HIP-backed HYG as ICRS-origin; no homogeneous reduction or precision guarantee is asserted.
astrometryImport.frameDerivation: Use engine src/calc-frames.ts: transpose(frameMatrix("equatorial-icrs", time)) on both direction and proper-motion tangent, then reproject the tangent onto the transformed RA/Dec bases.
astrometryImport.motionBasis: HIP convention from ESA section 1.2.5; publisher says most HYG motion originates in Hipparcos.
astrometryImport.missingMotion: null; do not coerce blanks to zero
astrometryImport.epochPolicy: HYG has already propagated positions to J2000; do not apply the original Hipparcos epoch shift again.
